description: Shared render-behavior tag contract fields for Efficio shapes.

efficio_render_behavior.description: Controls whether a shape renders by component type, is preserved as-is, or is removed before render.

ai.purpose: Tells the renderer how to treat the shape.

enum_descriptions.render_by_component_type: Render the shape using its component type contract.
enum_descriptions.preserve: Keep the shape exactly as authored; do not generate content for it.
enum_descriptions.remove_on_render: Drop the shape from the rendered output (mock/preview only).
